description: This file provides a PEAR DB emulation layer for the ADOdb PHP database abstraction library. It includes definitions for constants, a main DB class for creating and managing database connections, and parsing for data source names. It also includes external file inclusions, notably PEAR.php and other ADODB-related includes.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to instantiate database connections, parse DSN strings, and check for extension availability within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction layer.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates a new database connection object for the specified database type.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection based on the provided DSN and options.

methods.name: apiVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of the DB API implemented.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if a given value is an error object.

methods.name: isWarning
methods.description: Checks if a given value is a warning object (always returns false in this code).

methods.name: parseDSN
methods.description: Parses a Data Source Name string into its components like phptype, hostspec, database, etc.

methods.name: assertExtension
methods.description: Attempts to load a PHP extension if it is not already loaded.
